title: Audio Evaluation Metrics
motto: You cannot ship what you cannot measure. This lesson names the 2026 metrics for every audio task: ASR (WER, CER, RTFx), TTS (MOS, UTMOS, SECS, WER-on-ASR-round-trip), audio-language (MMAU, LongAudioBench), music (FAD, CLAP), and speaker (EER). Plus the leaderboards where you compare.

steps.body: You cannot ship what you cannot measure. This lesson names the 2026 metrics for every audio task: ASR (WER, CER, RTFx), TTS (MOS, UTMOS, SECS, WER-on-ASR-round-trip), audio-language (MMAU, LongAudioBench), music (FAD, CLAP), and speaker (EER). Plus the leaderboards where you compare.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Every audio task has multiple metrics, each measuring a different axis. Using the wrong metric is how you ship a model that looks great on your dashboard and terribly in production. The 2026 canonical list:
